objective: Close the formal metadata-authority gap between the retained legacy EPDM window-handle fallback and the active physical aluminum crescent-latch assembly without claiming rendered quality.
problemFound: material_construction_lookdev.json intentionally still records HD_WindowHandle_ as EPDM fallback provenance, while the formal facade path disables all 60 of those renderers and replaces their visible role with FacadeSashLatchHardware governed by facade_sash_latch_contract.json. Without an explicit machine-readable authority bridge, a reviewer or future QA could incorrectly treat the inactive EPDM record as active visible latch material metadata, weakening the missing-construction/material-metadata critical-fail guarantee.

changes.summary: Added QualityBlockSashLatchMetadataAuthorityQA. It cross-validates the central sliding-window fallback record, the physical sash-latch contract, canonical anodized-aluminum and galvanized-steel material metadata, mandatory manufacture/installation fields, physical dimensions, LOD policy and zero-point render-pending policy. QA4K_ and QATemporal_ camera pre-cull paths also delegate to the existing physical latch scene validator, so enabled legacy handles, non-canonical latch materials, stock primitive geometry or invalid LODs fail before formal evidence.

Added sash_latch_metadata_authority_contract.json defining legacy-fallback-only semantics, 60 disabled EPDM renderers, the superseding physical latch assembly/root, canonical metal material paths, 30-window/four-LOD/50-mm-pitch expectations, geometry-vs-material authority, 4K lookdev brief, critical-defect mapping and failure-injection cases.

staticCrossContractEvidence: Central sliding_window registry currently records HD_WindowHandle_ with materialId epdm_rubber and explicitly describes it as fallback hardware.

facade_sash_latch_contract.json identifies apartment_sliding_sash_crescent_latch, 30 windows, one lock per two-panel window, 50 mm screw pitch, MAT_AgedAluminum primary metal, MAT_DarkGalvanizedSteel fasteners, four LOD levels, disabled legacy rubber handles, reflection fingerprint binding, automaticVisualPoints=0 and renderVerificationPending=true.

QualityBlockFacadeSashLatchUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene already requires exactly 60 legacy handle renderers and fails if any is enabled; active latch renderers are restricted to canonical aluminum/fastener materials and purpose-built GM_SashLatch_ meshes with UV/normal/tangent data and no stock primitives.

The new authority QA requires the central aluminum material record to provide physically plausible albedo/roughness/metallic/specular-F0/normal/microstructure/wet/UV/angular-response metadata and cross-binds its asset path to the physical latch contract.

failureInjectionPlan: Enable one HD_WindowHandle_ renderer and confirm formal pre-cull scene QA fails instead of accepting EPDM fallback as visible hardware.
Change the central legacy materialId away from epdm_rubber without updating the authority bridge and confirm config QA fails.
Change the physical latch primary material path away from MAT_AgedAluminum.mat and confirm cross-contract QA fails.
Change the fastener material path away from MAT_DarkGalvanizedSteel.mat and confirm cross-contract QA fails.
Remove a mandatory manufacture/mounting/interfaces/aging/geometry-vs-material/lookdev field and confirm config QA fails.
Set automaticVisualPoints above zero or renderVerificationPending=false before actual native evidence and confirm config QA fails.

implementationReadiness.reason: Metadata authority for the physically upgraded sash lock is now explicit and fail-closed, but Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime and actual rendered evidence remain unavailable. Readiness is therefore not increased from the existing conservative value.
